name: propose_goal
description: Propose a session Goal for the user to approve. The user sees the objective in an approval dialog and decides; only their approval sets the Goal. This tool never sets one on its own. Unavailable in plan mode, in subagents, and in headless runs.

objective.description: The objective to propose, written so the Goal verifier can judge it from the transcript. At most 1500 characters; the user reads all of it in the approval dialog.
